hooks.name: firmware-doctor
hooks.command: p=$(for c in "${FIRMWARE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" "${OPENHANDS_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/plugins/firmware" "${HOME:-}/.agents/plugins/firmware" "${HOME:-}/.openhands/plugins/installed/firmware"; do [ -f "$c/scripts/firmware_launcher.py" ] && printf %s "$c" && break; done); [ -n "$p" ] || { echo "firmware plugin root unresolved" >&2; exit 1; }; exec python3 "$p/scripts/firmware_launcher.py" doctor --warn

hooks.name: protect-generated
hooks.command: p=$(for c in "${FIRMWARE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" "${OPENHANDS_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/plugins/firmware" "${HOME:-}/.agents/plugins/firmware" "${HOME:-}/.openhands/plugins/installed/firmware"; do [ -f "$c/hooks/scripts/protect_generated.py" ] && printf %s "$c" && break; done); [ -n "$p" ] || { echo "firmware plugin root unresolved" >&2; exit 2; }; exec python3 "$p/hooks/scripts/protect_generated.py"

hooks.name: safety-rail
hooks.command: p=$(for c in "${FIRMWARE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" "${OPENHANDS_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/plugins/firmware" "${HOME:-}/.agents/plugins/firmware" "${HOME:-}/.openhands/plugins/installed/firmware"; do [ -f "$c/hooks/scripts/safety_rail.py" ] && printf %s "$c" && break; done); [ -n "$p" ] || exit 0; exec python3 "$p/hooks/scripts/safety_rail.py"

hooks.name: report-firmware-status
hooks.command: p=$(for c in "${FIRMWARE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" "${OPENHANDS_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/plugins/firmware" "${HOME:-}/.agents/plugins/firmware" "${HOME:-}/.openhands/plugins/installed/firmware"; do [ -f "$c/hooks/scripts/report_firmware_status.py" ] && printf %s "$c" && break; done); [ -n "$p" ] || { echo "firmware plugin root unresolved" >&2; exit 1; }; exec python3 "$p/hooks/scripts/report_firmware_status.py"
